Name: Bachelorette Confessions
Author: Avren9
Description:
Inspired by the “Reverse Proposal” mod for bachelors, adds brand new confession events for Stardew Valley’s six bachelorettes (Abigail, Haley, Leah, Maru, Penny, and Emily), letting them take the initiative and confess their feelings to you.

Once you reach eight hearts with them [b]and[/b] have seen their eight‑heart event, they’ll confess to the player on the farm the very next morning—as long as it’s a sunny, non‑festival day.

You can customize the confession events by editing the text in the I18n file.
